name: Luna Precursor Mission Profile
description: Initial precursor mission to establish Luna infrastructure: landing pads, comms, power grid, and inflatable tank farm. Concurrent Venus skimmer launch for supplemental N₂ delivery.

phases.name: Precursor Launch from Earth
phases.description: Launch precursor HLT with landing pad components, comms array, and RTG power grid.

phases.name: Venus Skimmer Launch (Concurrent)
phases.description: Launch Venus atmospheric harvester concurrently with precursor. Harvests CO₂ + N₂ from Venus atmosphere.

phases.name: Landing Pad Construction
phases.description: Deploy 2 landing pads, comms array, and RTG power grid at Luna.

phases.name: Initial HLT Landings
phases.description: HLT #1 lands with inflatable tanks. Tank farm setup begins.

phases.name: Venus Atmospheric Harvester Arrival
phases.description: Venus skimmer arrives at Luna with harvested N₂ + CO₂ payload. Gates habitat pressurization.
